svg.text: Runs nightly at 05:00 UTC · Databricks · openalex-walden
merge all 6 sources into one raw works table (Delta)
merge landing page & PDF data into author records: names, affiliations, corresponding-author flag
build unified location records: URLs, license, OA status, abstract — one row per paper per source
attach journal record; classify as journal / repository / preprint server
link preprints to their published versions
using Crossref is-preprint-of and arXiv metadata
assign canonical OpenAlex IDs to every paper;
central Delta table — all papers with enriched locations, canonical IDs, and volume info
join: authorships + topics + concepts + references + fulltext → optimize Delta table
fails the run if >7.5M works changed tonight; skips all publishing until manually cleared
separate override flags per consequence class (guardrails / deleted-works / locations / unpaywall)
7 · PUBLISH (all run in parallel after Guardrails passes)
Gates: Merge_Declared_Links and Affiliation_Matcher pass either way so downstream always runs
